text:
maya: Quick heads up — saw weird grant scoping in Console. When I open project infra-demo -> Service Keys -> 'Grant scope' dropdown it lists org-level grants (e.g. Billing: view) and they render like project-scoped options. I created a project key and the saved payload included an org grant. :grimacing:

arjun: Yikes. Can you paste repro steps + the network request payload?

maya: Repro steps:
1) Org: redwood-test
2) Project: infra-demo
3) Console -> New Key -> choose role 'project.reader'
4) UI suggestion list also showed 'Billing: view (org)' and it appeared selected in the preview
5) Save -> key works but scope list contains an org grant I never explicitly picked

Network payload from browser console (trimmed):
```
{"name":"infra-demo-key","scopes":["projects:infra-demo:project.reader","orgs:redwood-test:billing.view"]}
```

I also confirmed via API: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/verify` returns the same scopes.

arjun: Hmm. My guess: suggester normalizes labels with an org prefix for display, and the UI might be sending the normalized label back as an id. @sophia did you change the suggester normalization recently?

sophia: I pushed a change last week to canonicalize role labels so they show context (org/project) — purely for display. It should not mutate the internal ids we send to the backend. I'll check the console handler; maybe the dropdown value is bound to the label instead of the id.

jonathan: Regardless, backend should be defensive: if a key is created under a project, we must reject any `orgs:`-prefixed scopes. Add a validator that returns 400 with a clear error. Also log telemetry for any attempts.

maya: Agreed. Short-term mitigation: add an API guard that rejects org-scoped grants on project keys. Canary rollout to Dedicated region, then global.

arjun: Also we should run a historical audit for mixed-scope keys. Quick query idea: `SELECT key_id, created_at, scopes FROM key_audit WHERE scopes LIKE '%orgs:%' AND key_type='project' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100`

sophia: I'll open a PR to fix the UI binding so dropdown emits internal ids and add a unit test. Will also add an e2e that asserts the saved payload only contains `projects:` scopes for project keys.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: console-grants-fix -> staging at 1719993000

maya: Good. Also add a dashboard tile under Console -> Security -> Keys: "Mixed-scope keys (org in project)" and an alert if > 5/day. We want early visibility in case this was a batch issue.

arjun: I'll wire the telemetry metric and alert. Will add a pager to teams/platform-oncall for > 20/day.

maya: Follow-ups: sophia -> PR + tests, arjun -> telemetry + dashboard + alert, jonathan -> backend validator + migration/rollback plan, maya -> customer outreach if we find leaked org grants.

sophia: PR opened (WIP): https://git.redwood/repo/console/pulls/482 :eyes:

jonathan: For rollout safety I propose validator supports an `allowlist_orgs` flag for orgs we know have legitimate cross-scope use (rare). We'll keep it off by default and flip via feature flag if needed.

maya: Nice. Thanks all — let's track in the console-grants board and sync tomorrow if PRs land. :thumbsup:
